title: Seal one-time pairing messages
responsibility: Derive separate pairing request and approval keys and encrypt or decrypt their JSON payloads.

inputs.name: pairingEnvelope.context
inputs.description: Contains the host and pairing identifiers, the phone one-time public key, the host public key, and their ECDH secret. The identifiers and byte arrays are incorporated into the pairing salt, while the secret is used to derive key material.

inputs.name: sealPairing.key
inputs.description: AES-GCM key used to seal one message for the selected purpose. The fixed zero-byte nonce makes the derived key single-use; the function does not track reuse.

inputs.name: sealPairing.kind
inputs.description: Selects the request or approval purpose. It determines the additional authenticated data used for encryption.

inputs.name: sealPairing.value
inputs.description: Value passed to JSON.stringify and encrypted as its resulting text. It should be JSON-serializable; serialization can reject values such as cyclic objects or BigInt.
inputs.unknownReason: The pairing message is supplied for JSON serialization and can have the caller's chosen shape.

inputs.name: openPairing.key
inputs.description: AES-GCM key used to open a message sealed for the selected purpose. Authentication succeeds only with the matching key and purpose.

inputs.name: openPairing.kind
inputs.description: Purpose expected for the ciphertext: request or approval. It must match the purpose used when sealing because it selects the authenticated additional data.

inputs.name: openPairing.sealed
inputs.description: Base64url encoding of the AES-GCM ciphertext and authentication tag returned by sealPairing. Any changed byte, a different key, or a different purpose prevents successful authentication.

outputs.name: pairingEnvelope
outputs.description: Resolves to separate request and approval AES-GCM keys derived from the context secret and bound to both identifiers and public keys. Each key is intended to seal one message for its corresponding purpose.

outputs.name: sealPairing
outputs.description: Resolves to base64url encoding of the AES-GCM ciphertext and authentication tag for JSON.stringify(value). Encryption uses a twelve-byte zero IV and purpose-specific additional authenticated data.

outputs.name: openPairing
outputs.description: Resolves to the value produced by JSON.parse after AES-GCM authentication, decryption, and byte-to-text conversion. The result can be any JSON value.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: sealPairing rejects if JSON.stringify(value) throws, for example for a cyclic value or a BigInt without a JSON conversion.

errors.name: OperationError
errors.description: openPairing rejects when AES-GCM authentication fails, including when the key or purpose differs or ciphertext bytes have changed.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: openPairing rejects if the authenticated plaintext is not valid JSON for JSON.parse.
